description.value: Chau Café is a Vietnamese restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver serving vegan and vegetarian cuisine. It sits in a residential commercial strip in the Kensington-Cedar Cottage area, a neighbourhood popular with cyclists commuting through southeast Vancouver. The OSM record was verified as recently as April 2026, suggesting the business remains active.
